value.name: lucia decides to edit from the apartment
value.description: Lucia insists she can and wants to edit from the apartment, framing the move as part of the arrangement and partly for herself.
evidence: "I can edit from here. I would like to edit from here."
"I am telling you what I have decided to do. It is not for you. It is for the arrangement. It is also, partly, for me."

value.name: daniel accepts lucia's decision
value.description: After a brief silence, Daniel agrees to Lucia's decision without further argument.
evidence: "Daniel was quiet. Then he said, \"All right.\""

value.name: asha revises the closing schedule note
value.description: Asha writes a note about a larger down payment and a revised schedule, then crosses out her earlier urgency about Wednesday.
evidence: Asha wrote a note on her pad. The note said: *larger down payment at closing, schedule revised accordingly, draft by Wednesday.*
She underlined *Wednesday* and then, after a moment, crossed out the underline, because there was no longer any particular urgency about Wednesday.
The urgency had gone out of the file at some point over the last forty-eight hours and she had not, until this moment, noticed it leaving.

value.name: asha introduces the life tenancy item
value.description: Asha moves the discussion to the life tenancy provision, signaling a new item in the arrangement.

value.name: rosa prepares to review tenancy terms
value.description: Rosa reacts to the life tenancy item by straightening in her chair, indicating her attention and readiness to proceed.
evidence: Rosa straightened slightly in her chair.

value.name: asha recalls prior review with rosa
value.description: The scene reveals that Asha previously walked Rosa through the life tenancy language, answered her practical questions, and received Rosa's tentative approval.
evidence: Asha had walked Rosa through the language on Friday, in the office, with the door closed, and Rosa had read it twice and then asked two questions, both of them practical, both of them sharp, and Asha had answered them, and Rosa had said, "All right, then," and signed nothing, because there was nothing yet to sign.

value.name: asha brings the tenancy document for signing
value.description: Asha notes that there is now something to sign and presents the life tenancy paperwork in a folder.
evidence: Today there was something to sign.
Asha had brought it in a folder.

value.name: asha begins explaining rosa's life tenancy rights
value.description: Asha starts to explain that the life tenancy will give Rosa use of the third-floor rooms.
evidence: "The life tenancy," Asha said, "gives Rosa the use of the third-floor rooms
